title: Strassman's repeat-dose DMT tests showing no tolerance
summary: Andrew Gallimore tells of Strassman's repeat-dose DMT tests showing no tolerance, about 1990s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Rick Strasman studied this during his 1990s studies. He would inject someone

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, refers to studies in the 1990s by Rick Strassman, a doctor who gave volunteers DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, by injection. According to Gallimore, Strassman gave people repeated doses and found their bodies did not build up tolerance to it, which Gallimore treats as a clue that DMT plays some special role in the brain.
